steps.content:
Root cause analysis complete. The account's daily cost jumped from a stable ~$25,500 baseline to $27,390 on 2025-10-20 (and stayed elevated). Per-resource comparison against the Oct 10–19 baseline shows exactly one resource with an anomalous increase:

- **GCP / ZfOgd / app 0QF / instance family QD9Fr0KXz9**: instance count spiked from a fluctuating 7–10 to 49/day (+1,598/day cost), accounting for essentially the entire anomaly delta (~+1,680 total; remaining changes are within noise). This is the root cause.

Other changes were not causal: AWS 6mBxV/2m9/Jg50IWfSz0 price rose from $0.45→$1.50 (+453.6) when its commitment expired 10/19/25, but this was offset by a matching decrease in 6mBxV/aig/IXI4IjtplF (a new commitment starting 10/20/25, −367.2), so those net out and aren't the driver of the jump.

- **GCP / ZfOgd / app 0QF / instance family QD9Fr0KXz9**: instance count spiked from a fluctuating 7–10 to 49/day (+1,598/day cost), accounting for essentially the entire anomaly delta (~+1,680 total; remaining changes are within noise). This is the root cause.

Other changes were not causal: AWS 6mBxV/2m9/Jg50IWfSz0 price rose from $0.45→$1.50 (+453.6) when its commitment expired 10/19/25, but this was offset by a matching decrease in 6mBxV/aig/IXI4IjtplF (a new commitment starting 10/20/25, −367.2), so those net out and aren't the driver of the jump.
